mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that boosts equity market returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during easing periods than tightening periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher unemployment reduces consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both increase, it signals a strong demand environment that boosts equity market returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average triggers a negative signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as reduced production signals slowing economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) both increase, it signals a tightening monetary environment that reduces equity market returns, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong economic growth boosts equity market returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher during strong GDP growth periods than weak growth periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decrease, it signals a strong labor market environment that boosts equity market returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strong labor market periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average triggers a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as reduced inflation signals a more favorable business environment.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal.
